baseline_models.reading: The ayah pronounces woe on the مُطَفِّفِينَ: in the ordinary morphological reading, people who make a due amount deficient or short.

focus_anchor.role: The prepositional phrase names the class to whom the woe is directed.

baseline_models.mechanism: The concise nominal threat is already complete at the focus: وَيْلٌ is directed to the named agent-class, so the baseline remains a warning about a deficiency-making practice rather than importing a later scene.
baseline_models.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus wording and identifies its QAC root as ط ف ف, but supplies no mapped branch for that root. The gloss 'make a due amount deficient or short' is an ordinary-Arabic morphological inference; without the following ayat it need not be limited to a particular commodity or transaction.
baseline_models.containment: Keep this as the ordinary, focus-only baseline. Do not claim a packet-supplied lexical branch for ط ف ف, and qualify any more specific commercial or moral account as contextually activated.

context_deltas.reading: The مُطَفِّفِينَ are specified as agents of an asymmetric exchange: they seek completion when receiving from people, yet make the other side's measure or weight deficient when giving.

focus_anchor.role: The named target is specified by the immediately following relative clauses.

activation_trace.role: The supplied image is measuring out food, grounding the receiving-side act in a measured exchange.
Its complete fullness without shortfall image gives force to يَسْتَوْفُونَ.
The scale-of-justice image makes the giving-side alternative a weighted as well as measured due.
Its supplied image is specifically shorting measure and weight, making the deficit explicit.

structural_cues.role: The first conditional portrays their receiving-side demand for full completion.
The paired conditional reverses direction and explicitly states the other side's loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The parallel conditionals create a two-sided comparison: full taking for oneself is set against deficient giving to others. That syntactic reversal specifies what the focus's deficiency-making label condemns.

changed_reading.before: A general warning against making a due amount short.
changed_reading.after: A warning against reciprocal unfairness: claiming a full due while denying the corresponding full due to another.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The text and supplied branch images establish measure, completion, weight, and shorting. Reading the two clauses as a morally charged asymmetry is a reader inference from their deliberately paired, opposed directions; the packet does not state a separate legal rule or limit the scene to one market practice.
context_deltas.containment: Retain the concrete measured-exchange reading. Do not turn it into a claim that every form of deficiency elsewhere in the chapter is a literal sale, nor add details about instruments, prices, or legal penalties not supplied here.

context_deltas.reading: The woe is not merely an immediate rebuke: the subsequent question makes the deficiency-making practice answerable to resurrection and standing before the Lord of the worlds.

focus_anchor.role: The warning at the opening gains its stated horizon from the following challenge to the same preceding people.

activation_trace.role: The supplied rousing-a-still-thing image supports the force of مَّبْعُوثُونَ within the explicit question.
This branch explicitly includes resurrection and people standing before their Lord.

structural_cues.role: The rhetorical question directly follows the exchange description and introduces being raised.
The brief continuation qualifies the expected raising with a great day.
It spells out the day as people standing before the Lord of the worlds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening classification is followed by an interrogative about whether 'those' expect raising, then by the day of standing. The sequence shifts the force of وَيْلٌ from a local consequence to accountability before God.

changed_reading.before: A condemnation of one-sided shorting in exchange.
changed_reading.after: A condemnation whose seriousness is framed by being raised and standing for divine reckoning.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies resurrection and standing language. Treating أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ as the preceding مُطَفِّفِينَ is a sequential antecedent inference; the noun is not repeated in 83:4. No additional account of how judgment occurs is assumed.
context_deltas.containment: State this as the chapter's accountability horizon, not as a detailed doctrine reconstructed from these verses alone. Preserve the antecedent linkage as a strong sequential reading rather than an explicitly repeated identification.

context_deltas.reading: The opening deficit can further be read as an auditable moral wrong: the chapter frames wrongdoers and the righteous through contrasted books, with the same marked-book phrase repeated on both sides.

focus_anchor.role: The initial condemned class is read within the chapter's ensuing contrast between wrongdoers and the righteous.

activation_trace.role: The supplied branch gives writing and a written book as the concrete image for كِتَٰبَ.
Its image of marked writing in a book or record gives specificity to مَّرْقُومٌ.
The repeated written-book image supports the later righteous-side counterpart.

structural_cues.role: The chapter introduces the book of the wrongdoers.
The wrongdoer-side book is characterized as marked.
A formally parallel book is then assigned to the righteous.
Exact repetition of the marked-book phrase makes the contrast structurally conspicuous.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated wording turns the later moral landscape into a paired, recorded classification. In that setting, the opening's making a due deficient reads not as a private discrepancy that disappears, but as conduct situated under disclosed differentiation.

changed_reading.before: Shorting another in a concrete exchange.
changed_reading.after: Shorting another as a morally legible wrong set within a contrast of marked records and ultimate classifications.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies books, marking, and their formal contrast. Connecting the initial class to the wrongdoer-side record is a chapter-level sequential inference, not an explicit assertion that every مُطَفِّف is individually identical with every فَاجِر or that the books are commercial ledgers.
context_deltas.containment: Use 'auditable' and 'recorded' figuratively at the level warranted by the book-and-mark wording. Do not infer numerical transaction records, a named register, or a one-to-one identity between the opening class and all later categories.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: Exploratorily, the deficit image can illuminate a social form of shorting: criminals laugh at believers, declare them astray, and implicitly assume a guarding authority the text denies them; the final reversal exposes that valuation as answerable to recompense.

focus_anchor.role: The focus supplies the anchored image of making another's due deficient, which is cautiously extended from quantity to fair social valuation.

activation_trace.role: The supplied image is going astray from guidance and aim, clarifying the accusation directed at the believers.
Its preserving-and-guarding image sharpens the denied role of حَٰفِظِينَ.
The branch's recompense-returning-to-the-doer image grounds the closing reversal.

structural_cues.quote_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
structural_cues.role: The later scene begins with criminals laughing at believers.
Their laughter becomes an explicit adverse judgment of the believers.
The text denies that they were sent as guardians over the believers.

structural_cues.quote_ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
structural_cues.role: The final scene reverses the earlier social posture.

structural_cues.quote_ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
structural_cues.role: The closing question frames the reversal as return for what they did.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: A material deficit is extended, cautiously, to an evaluative one: the later speakers reduce believers' standing while presuming a supervisory role they lack. The reversal and recompense scene make that unfair social allocation resonate with the opening warning.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns making a measured due deficient.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also supplies an image for withholding fair recognition from others through unauthorized, contemptuous judgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The later scene explicitly gives mockery, the charge of being astray, denial of guardianship, reversal, and recompense. The application of the focus's deficit image to social valuation is reader-supplied; the packet does not equate the criminals in 83:29 with the مُطَفِّفِينَ or define ط ف ف as mockery.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Keep this as a surprising, cross-domain hypothesis only. Downstream prose should say 'can illuminate' rather than identify the groups or replace the immediate measure-and-weight reading.

summary.ordinary_reading: 83:1 warns the مُطَفِّفِينَ, ordinarily read as people who make a due amount deficient. The immediate paired conditionals specify the core case: taking full measure for oneself and giving short measure or weight to others.
coexisting_readings: The immediate syntax retains a concrete reciprocal-exchange reading: completion for oneself versus loss for the other side.
The warning also carries an eschatological horizon through raising and people standing before the Lord of the worlds.
The repeated marked-book wording lets the opening deficit be read as morally legible within contrasted records, without turning those books into commercial ledgers.
Exploratorily, the later mockery-and-reversal scene can resonate with the focus as unfair social valuation, but it does not replace the material exchange reading.
unresolved_limits: ط ف ف is listed among roots without branches, so the packet provides no internal branch inventory for the focus root itself.

The sequence strongly links the opening group to the subsequent challenge, but the noun مُطَفِّفِينَ is not repeated in 83:4 and the packet does not explicitly equate it with every later category of wrongdoer.
The paired books are marked written records in the supplied material; their exact administrative form and any transaction-by-transaction scope are not specified.
